keys: What the vendor calls the distinction

Amazon.Count as an axis: named: theme SIZE/COLOR/NUMBER_OF_ITEMS makes number_of_items mandatory; legacy count → ITEM_PACKAGE_QUANTITY; workbook valid values Color · Count · SizeName · SizeName-ColorName.
Amazon.Separate pack / bundle mechanism: ItemRelationship.type = PACKAGE_HIERARCHY (“a package container or is contained by the related items”) and ItemClassification = PRODUCT_BUNDLE (“A parent catalog item that represents a bundle of items”) — first-party 2026-09-21.

Walmart.Count as an axis: named: “Color · Size · Pattern · Character · Count · Count per pack · Multipack quantity · Theme”; count, countPerPack, multipackQuantity are the only axes Toothpastes (9) and Tires (18) share; ten food types have no variant mechanism at all.
Walmart.What the vendor calls the distinction: the shopper choosing on one page: “display multiple versions of the same product on a single Walmart item page … vary by color, size, flavor, pattern, count.”
Walmart.Example: ● Toothpastes variantAttributeNames.items.enum = [character, character_group, count, countPerPack, flavor, form, multipackQuantity, pieceCount, size]

Google.Count as an axis: expressible (no closed set of axes; variant_option.name free); the multipack is an offer attribute beside it.
Google.Separate pack / bundle mechanism: [multipack] integer (required for multipacks in AU, BR, CZ, FR, DE, IT, JP, NL, ES, CH, UK, US) + [is_bundle] yes/no.
Google.What the vendor calls the distinction: inference: item_group_id renders a picker; multipack lets a comparison normalise price-per-unit — different jobs.

eBay.Count as an axis: yes, measured 2026-09-21: Number in Pack is aspectEnabledForVariations: true on 12 of 12 grocery leaves; Unit Quantity false on 12 of 12 (item-level).
eBay.What the vendor calls the distinction: per-aspect eligibility: “Not all aspects are allowed as a pivoting aspect.”
eBay.Example: ● Number in Pack {aspectDataType: STRING, aspectMode: FREE_TEXT, aspectRequired: false, aspectUsage: OPTIONAL, aspectEnabledForVariations: true} (leaf 257998)

Shopify.Count as an axis: expressible — ProductOption.name free text; no count attribute on any of 9 food taxonomy nodes.
Shopify.Separate pack / bundle mechanism: not in the record (bundles are an app surface; not collected).
Shopify.What the vendor calls the distinction: the taxonomy carries pack form: Package type (1456: Bag, Bottle, Box, Can, Canister, Case, Dispenser, Flip-top, …) on Soda — live 2026-09-21.

Shopee.Separate pack / bundle mechanism: kit items: add_kit_item / update_kit_item / get_kit_item_info with item_setting.model_list[] {tier_index, model_sku, original_price, component_list[] {component_item_id, component_model_id, quantity, main_component}} + its own tier_variation_list[].
Shopee.What the vendor calls the distinction: a containment edge (component_list) — the kit may itself have variants; nothing makes a kit a sibling of its component.

Tokopedia.Count as an axis: expressible — built-in id or custom name; max 3 sales attributes.
Tokopedia.Separate pack / bundle mechanism: skus[].combined_skus[] {product_id Y, sku_id Y, sku_count: int Y} — structured spec 2026-09-21.
Tokopedia.What the vendor calls the distinction: a bundle is composed on the SKU from other SKUs with counts; the axis stays sales_attributes.

Salesforce B2C.Count as an axis: expressible — variation attributes per master; no kind restriction retrieved.
Salesforce B2C.Example: ● XSD: classification-category, variations, images, product-set-products, bundled-products, custom-attributes

Magento.Separate pack / bundle mechanism: not collected in the record (Magento generally ships a bundle type_id — outside the thirteen records, not cited here).
Magento.Example: ● catalog_product_entity.type_id is a static column (record); its value set is not enumerated in the record.

WooCommerce.Count as an axis: expressible — one bool per attribute entry (is_variation).

commercetools.Count as an axis: expressible — any definition may carry attributeConstraint: CombinationUnique.

Akeneo.Count as an axis: expressible, type-gated — a count fits metric or simple select (six vendor statements, three answers on the allowed types).
Akeneo.Separate pack / bundle mechanism: not collected as a bundle mechanism; the record lists rawQuantifiedAssociations among the product's non-attribute columns (a quantified association), with no bundle semantics stated.
